reader.requirement: At 85 a DISPLAY of several operands (identifiers of any class the edition admits, literals, figurative constants, ALL literals, reference-modified and variable-length items, edited items) must transfer them as one sending item, in written order, with nothing inserted between successive operands and the device position unchanged between them; WITH NO ADVANCING carries the position into the next DISPLAY.

edition-consulted.switches: refuses END-DISPLAY (EndDisplay2002) and a numeric literal operand that is not an unsigned integer (DisplayNumericLiteral2002, §1985:VI.6.10.3 SR2) below 2002

reader.edition-search: grep for DialectLevel/Edition/CobolVersion/ConstructRegistry/DialectBehavior in AcceptDisplayBinder.cs, AcceptDisplayEmitter.cs and OperandText.cs found none; the emitter joins every operand's device string with + and writes once (Write or WriteLine); --numeric-display is a compile option, not an edition
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: disp6.cob prints identical lines at --std 85 and --std 2023; only the operand forms admitted differ (END-DISPLAY and signed/fractional literals refused at 85)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: ca3_figurative_display_pcs covers figurative operands; the probes add alphanumeric+numeric concatenation, ALL literal, reference modification, an ODO group at two lengths, numeric-edited, signed numeric, LOW/HIGH-VALUE and NO ADVANCING continuation

probes.expected: each operand's image back to back with no separator in written order; ODO group at its current length (2 then 4); one occurrence of each figurative (GR3); NO ADVANCING leaves the position after the last operand (GR8)

probes.printed: COBOL0816 END-DISPLAY requires COBOL-2002; COBOL0900 for -1 and for 1.5 (not unsigned integers)
probes.expected: refused at 85: END-DISPLAY is not in the 1985 format; §1985:VI.6.10.3 SR2 numeric literal must be an unsigned integer

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.10.4 GR6  (6.10.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR6

reader.notes: The emitter builds ONE string from every operand's device conversion joined with + and writes it in a single Write/WriteLine, so no separator or repositioning can come between operands. The HIGH-VALUE image (U+FFFF written as UTF-8 EF BF BF) is GR1's implementor-defined conversion, outside this rule.

refuter.evidence: disp6r.cob at --std 85 (runs/disp6r-002): ODO group at 0 occurrences prints only its fixed part '<<'; ALL "AB" once (GR3); BINARY/COMP-3/SIGN LEADING SEPARATE/JUSTIFIED/BLANK WHEN ZERO elementary operands concatenated with no separator; a group of X, COMP-3 9(3), BINARY 9(4), X transfers its 6 storage bytes '[' 12 3F 01 02 ']' back to back, so the sending item is the sum of the operands' sizes. disp6c.cob: X"41", N"B", B"1" operands refused at 85 (COBOL0900), as 1985 has only nonnumeric and numeric literals. Index data item as an operand refused (COBOL1694), correct for 1985 (USAGE INDEX referenced only in SEARCH/SET/relation/USING). Emitter joins every operand and writes once (AcceptDisplayEmitter.cs#EmitDisplay). cite: OK  §1985:VI.6.10.4 GR6  (6.10.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR6.
